scripts.title: Axon Hub | Auto Farm, Auto Throw, Auto Rebirth & Auto Hatch
scripts.features:
Axon Hub for +1 Stone Skipping brings Auto Farm, Auto Throw, Auto Train, Auto Rebirth, and Auto Hatch together in one hub. Automate repetitive grinding, upgrade your stone, hatch pets, and collect available rewards with customizable settings.

🪨 AUTO FARM, AUTO THROW & TRAINING

- Auto Throw repeatedly launches your stone to farm Wins.
- Waits for each throw to finish before starting the next.
- Automatically returns to the throwing zone when needed.
- Closes blocking menus so the throwing loop can continue.
- Auto Train / Auto Practice for Skill farming.
- Automatically selects the best unlocked training deck.
- Choose a specific training zone instead of automatic selection.
- Track Skill per minute, Wins per minute, completed throws, and your longest throw.

♻️ AUTO REBIRTH & STONE UPGRADES

- Auto Rebirth when the requirements are met.
- Configure extra levels to gain before rebirthing.
- Auto Buy Best Stone purchases and equips the strongest affordable stone.
- Manually select a stone to buy and equip.
- Travel between unlocked worlds.
- View zone targets, level progress, and your Skill multiplier.
- Automatic tutorial completion handles remaining steps and stops when finished.

🥚 AUTO HATCH & PETS

- Auto Buy Eggs and Auto Hatch your selected egg.
- Stop hatching when your selected pet rarity is obtained.
- Skip the hatch animation.
- Display hatch results and egg chances.
- Enable the game's built-in Auto Equip Best Pets setting.
- View owned pets and your best pet.
- Claim available pet-index milestone rewards.

🎁 AUTO REWARDS & BOOSTS

- Auto Claim Daily Rewards.
- Auto Claim Playtime Gifts as they become available.
- Claim eligible offline earnings and group rewards.
- Auto Equip Best Title for your selected bonus.
- Auto Use Skill, Win, and Luck boosts.
- Configure boost usage and keep a reserve of potions.
- Redeem codes directly from the hub.

👁️ ESP & MOVEMENT

- ESP for launch zones, training areas, stone shops, egg shops, world portals, and players.
- Adjustable ESP distance.
- Walking or teleport movement.
- Custom Walk Speed, Fly, Noclip, and Infinite Jump.
- Controls for game effects, pet visibility, HUD visibility, and FPS cap.

⚙️ SESSION & CONFIGURATION

- Anti-AFK, server hopping, and rejoin controls.
- Save, load, and autoload your configurations.
- Quick-access feature keybinds.
- Optional Discord webhook progress reports.
- Live farming statistics and session tracking.
- Panic Stop to pause automated actions.
